name: Rover (Electro)

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T4 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: Free 5-star Electro Sword Hybrid applying Electro Flare (up to 15 stacks) and buffing Negative Status characters; currently considered close to unusable in the meta pending a future Electro Flare-focused Main DPS to pair with. Has an unused 'Apex Resonance' pseudo-DPS mode (Thrum of All Sounds, multi-element).

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Deterrence (4 hits) / Parry Stance -> Riposte Strike.
skills.forte: Myriad Omens' Mandate - governs Electric Surge (max 120) -> Resonance Skill: Overshock (tap: team ATK buff; hold: Apex Resonance multi-element combo) -> Thunder Rage.
skills.outro: Rumbling Thunders - grants Electro Core to next character (consumed on next Negative Status inflicted for 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s); expires on swap.

echoSet: Moonlit Clouds (best - 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro)

teams.name: Fallback (Hiyuki)
teams.notes: Only current niche - a replacement buffer for Hiyuki teams when low-Sequence Jianxin is the only alternative.

rotation: Intro -> Basic 1-4 -> Skill -> Basic: Repel (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Skill: Overshock (cancel via Echo) -> Echo (swap) -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: essentially non-functional in the current meta at release - buffs too weak for any real synergy, Outro expires on swap (unusual for a Negative Status character), and Apex Resonance's multi-element DPS mode costs too much field time for the damage it deals; awaiting a future Electro Flare DPS to give her a purpose.
